title: Reframe Fleet as distributed resource operating system
description: Integrate the distributed-resource-os handoff into Fleet's canonical specification, architecture, decisions, plan, status, and README without changing implementation code.

logs.msg: Reframed Fleet's canonical private docs around the distributed resource OS handoff: typed resource graph, universal leases, hierarchical scheduling, cells, node OS, provider boundaries, compatibility adapters, and Rust-first target. Rewrote spec, design, decisions, plan, status, architecture notes, initial scope, research docs, and private index; updated tracked README.
